breakdown.description: The simulation is for natural convection in a fluid layer heated from below (along Z-axis), but gravity is applied horizontally (in the -X direction), which will not drive the vertical buoyant instability.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly sets the gravity vector to (0 0 -9.81), applying gravity in the -Z direction (vertical), which matches the ground truth and properly drives the buoyant instability for Rayleigh-Bénard convection with the height along the Z-axis. The original error of (-9.81 0 0) was not repeated.
